description:
One of the caller's saved products on the deployment's live lane and on a
second lane, against one cash position.

`second_origin` names the second lane's origin; `product_id` picks the
product (default: the first in `navigator.products`).
`second_quote_gbp_per_unit` and `second_lead_time_months` describe the
second lane; a measured sea transit replaces a typed lead time where the
lane is live. Each lane carries `unit_cost_provenance`,
`lead_time_provenance` and `duty_provenance` (READ or PROXY; duty is empty
when no rate was found). `available: false` with `missing` when the
comparison cannot be built.

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: compare_lanes
title: Compare lanes
